ar: ليه مش قادر ابعت لعدد كبير؟
en: Why can I only send 250 a day in my first weeks?

steps: New workspaces get 250 recipients/day for 14 days, counted across the owner's workspaces and own number
edgeCases: Counted before queueing, so a failed page overcounts for 24h
Anything over waits for the next day
gaps: Not documented in any merchant guide; UI wording for this pause reason is generic
